scripts.dev: npm run dev:prepare && concurrently -k -n api,web -c blue,green "npm:dev:api" "npm:dev:web"
scripts.dev:prepare: docker compose up -d --wait && cd services/api && uv sync && uv run alembic upgrade head
scripts.dev:api: cd services/api && uv run uvicorn app.main:app_factory --factory --reload --port 8000
